name: Enact Holdings, Inc.
summary:
Enact Holdings, Inc. (ACT) reported earnings of $1.21 per share on revenue of $312.07 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.26 per share on revenue of $312.26 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 3.97% while revenue grew 1.73% on a year-over-year basis.

Enact (Nasdaq: ACT), operating principally through its wholly-owned subsidiary Genworth Mortgage Insurance Corp. since 1981, is a leading U.S. private mortgage insurance provider committed to helping more people achieve the dream of homeownership.
subject: Enact Holdings, Inc. Missed Consensus Estimates
